note: Each until is a play_step / run_until expression tested at end of frame (true = chapter ends). Map-ready = [$070A]==0 && [$0729]==$0D. Level chapters end on the map once that level's completion bit in $7D00..$7D3F is set; bits not yet verified are found at the first clear by diffing the table (the runner reports newly set bits).

ram.map_ready: $0729 ($0D on the world map, $10 in a level)

fail.note: lives start at 4; a chapter played from a clean state starts at 4 too

generic_rule: a level chapter ends on the first map-ready frame where a new bit appeared in $7D00..$7D3F versus the chapter's start state
